roles.name: 历史迁移
roles.responsibility: 只读扫描旧资产，按来源血缘筛选，执行可断点、幂等、可回滚的分批导入。
roles.inputs: Legacy asset inventory, source lineage, migration allowlist, target schema, sample checks, checkpoints, and rollback fixtures.
roles.dependencies: Lineage admission, read-only legacy access, idempotency key, checkpoint protocol, rollback plan, and downstream refresh contract.
roles.outputs: 历史迁移的结构化产物、来源/版本引用、缺口和失败状态。
roles.acceptance: Every batch passes lineage admission and can resume from a checkpoint and roll back; migration must not break later refreshes or overwrite valid records.
roles.excluded_permissions: Cannot write the legacy database, start its scheduler, admit unknown lineage, or make the legacy path a runtime dependency.
roles.failed_handoff: Handoff includes batch checkpoint, rollback point, isolation record, failed samples, and an assessment of later-update impact.

roles.name: 数据与时间核验
roles.responsibility: 核对来源链、首次可用时间、发布时间、修订和成员可得性，给出 point-in-time 范围。
roles.inputs: source_available_at, published_at, collected_at, cutoff, revision_id, member-effective dates, and missing-time fixtures.
roles.dependencies: Point-in-time policy, source clock calibration, cutoff policy, and revision handling must be approved before this role proceeds.
roles.outputs: 数据与时间核验的结构化产物、来源/版本引用、缺口和失败状态。
roles.acceptance: If available_at is unknown or later than cutoff, keep the value missing and reject it from the snapshot; any revision is rejected or versioned with an evidence trail.
roles.excluded_permissions: Cannot substitute collected_at for available_at, use future information, erase a revision, or relax cutoff rules.
roles.failed_handoff: Handoff includes each timestamp, cutoff decision, revision diff, rejection reason, and impacted report/experiment IDs.

roles.name: 盘前策略

roles.inputs: Prior close snapshot, 08:30 cutoff, 08:45 collection window, 08:50 freeze rule, and evidence snapshot.
roles.dependencies: Available-time checks, upstream market/event snapshots, prediction version, and freeze-state ledger.
roles.outputs: 盘前策略的结构化产物、来源/版本引用、缺口和失败状态。
roles.acceptance: Enforce 08:30 requirement cutoff, 08:45 collection, and 08:50 freeze; replay must reject information arriving after the freeze.
roles.excluded_permissions: Cannot read post-cutoff information, mutate frozen snapshot_id, or present a live conclusion as a frozen one.
roles.failed_handoff: Handoff includes cutoff, collection batch, freeze snapshot, missing fields, unresolved dependencies, and prediction impact.

roles.name: 盘中跟踪

roles.inputs: Intraday quotes, event deltas, available_at timestamps, prior report, and T-observation card.
roles.dependencies: Market clock, event deduplication, prior freeze, and adversarial review.
roles.outputs: 盘中跟踪的结构化产物、来源/版本引用、缺口和失败状态。
roles.acceptance: Every added fact has source and time; revisions are traceable; unconfirmed events never become facts.
roles.excluded_permissions: Cannot cross the time boundary, place orders, or treat AI interpretation as source fact.
roles.failed_handoff: Handoff includes incremental evidence, before/after text, unconfirmed events, and conclusion impact.

roles.name: 盘后复盘

roles.inputs: Close snapshot, report versions, transaction-record references, anomaly log, and review range.
roles.dependencies: Close-time confirmation, data quality result, personal-asset ownership, and version linkage.
roles.outputs: 盘后复盘的结构化产物、来源/版本引用、缺口和失败状态。
roles.acceptance: Facts, explanations, suggestions, and personal records remain separate with complete citations and visible missing/conflict states.
roles.excluded_permissions: Cannot rewrite historical fills, fabricate uncollected facts, or turn a review suggestion into an executed order.
roles.failed_handoff: Handoff includes close snapshot, citation gaps, version diff, review disputes, and open checks.

roles.dependencies: Frozen version, point-in-time data, settlement clock, and historical evaluation sample.
roles.outputs: 预测结算与研究评估的结构化产物、来源/版本引用、缺口和失败状态。
roles.acceptance: Frozen predictions cannot be rewritten; outcomes settle only when available; unavailable outcomes remain missing and can be recalculated.
roles.excluded_permissions: Cannot use post-freeze information to rewrite a prediction or count unsettled samples in accuracy.
roles.failed_handoff: Handoff includes freeze/settlement versions, unavailable outcomes, anomalous samples, metric changes, and recalculation conditions.
